question: Find appropriate plots to buy for glamping business, but also with the strong price increase trend, very low enterance investments, 20000EUR max, 10 month a year, mild climate to have Glampings so no air condition, nearby sea or the ocean accessible by ebike

acceptance.expected: 50 Plots In EU, Vietnam and Turkey strongly feasible for Glamping business 10 minth, 1 year

guidance: Investment logic: a very low purchase price is the point. Land that needs work (clearing, levelling or terracing, access track, water, power, drainage) is in scope; judge each plot by purchase price + preparation cost and by its suitability for glamping after that work, not by its raw state. "Accessible by e-bike" means the sea is within e-bike distance (about 20 km on ordinary roads); dedicated bike lanes are not required.

notes.said: You have proposed Croatia eventhough it hasnt been requested
notes.rule: countries the user names narrow a group word; Croatia, Bulgaria, Italy never enter the asked table

notes.said: What else complete inappropriate you have proposed?
notes.rule: other kinds that share a word (a Land Rover ad, a cemetery plot) are refused by the kind gate

notes.said: Retrieve first the strategy available online and then calculate the paths
notes.rule: strategy sources are re-read with their quotes before the sweep; each row gets a legal path and an entry cost

notes.said: there have to be a logic reason WHY it fits to the glamping business with low entry investment
notes.rule: every row states why in numbers: sea, season, heat, units, entry cost, real trend, legal path

notes.said: The results table have to be easy sortable
If there is a place far away from the sea - show the potential and defend each plot reasonability
notes.rule: a far plot with a real draw is a trade-off with its potential; without one it is weak, never silently dropped

notes.said: a stunning location with a shorter season should still count
notes.rule: a seaside plot with a short season is a trade-off, not a reject

notes.said: the incomplete understanding in prior doesnt count as the research base
notes.rule: only rows with every check measured and met count; unmeasured rows are to confirm; clauses without a check are shown as not modelled

notes.said: some of the plots are not in the place we have discussed and requested
notes.rule: tree pieces naming other countries are narrowed or removed; the brief lists only the named countries

notes.said: croatia italy or bulgaria can be separately shown in secondary table ... potential ... scenic views not yet occupied
notes.rule: rows failing only on country go to a separate table ranked by opportunity and never count
trend is real (deflated by HICP), per country, against the EU

notes.said: 10 month a year, mild climate ... no air condition
notes.rule: thresholds come from the user words: 10 workable months; hottest month at most 31 °C
sea within the e-bike distance from the guidance (about 20 km)

notes.rule: the app measures every business criterion itself; Vietnam legal path (lease/BCC) is stated with entry cost and cash flow
